description: Test file for the cached discovery client in Kubernetes client-go, including tests for cache freshness, TTL, file permissions, openapi schema caching, and server group retrieval in various formats.

methods.name: TestCachedDiscoveryClient_Fresh
methods.description: Tests cache freshness behavior of the cached discovery client.

methods.name: TestNewCachedDiscoveryClient_TTL
methods.description: Tests TTL-based cache invalidation for the discovery client.

methods.name: TestNewCachedDiscoveryClient_PathPerm
methods.description: Verifies correct file permissions for cache files and directories.

methods.name: TestOpenAPIDiskCache
methods.description: Checks that openapi schema instances are cached and reused correctly.

methods.name: TestCachedDiscoveryClientUnaggregatedServerGroups
methods.description: Validates server group retrieval in unaggregated discovery format.

methods.name: TestCachedDiscoveryClientAggregatedServerGroups
methods.description: Validates server group retrieval in aggregated discovery format.
